hook: *3,469* of 3,619 booked for phoning while driving were on two-wheelers
hook_b: Phone in hand on the bike? *3,619* got booked, and all face court
tldr: Hyderabad Traffic Police booked 3,619 motorists for phone use while driving between Apr 26 and Oct 31.

beats.what: Traffic police booked 3,619 motorists for using phones while driving in a special drive.
beats.why: Police say phone use slows reaction time and raises accident risk.
beats.care: Caught on the phone while riding? Expect a court case, not just a challan.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The drive ran from Apr 26 to Oct 31. Of 3,619 violators, 3,469 were two-wheeler riders, 46 drove three-wheelers and 104 drove cars. All will be produced in court with charge sheets and penalised as per law. Joint CP (Traffic) D. Joel Davis said police follow zero tolerance and will run such drives regularly. The penalty amount was not in the report.

cards.q: Phone while driving: what works best?
How many cars were among the 3,619 booked?
cards.why: 104 four-wheeler drivers; 3,469 were on two-wheelers and 46 on three-wheelers.
